highlights: Engineered operational data workflows integrating Samsara telematics, SQL-based services, REST APIs, and Azure infrastructure to support fleet monitoring, operational analytics, and automated reporting.

Improved data consistency and freshness across distributed Azure workloads by implementing reliable cache invalidation, authoritative reads, concurrency handling, and synchronization between transactional writes and downstream read models.

Designed robust batch processing and data-import workflows using idempotency, deduplication, canonical identifiers, preflight validation, and transactional safeguards to prevent duplicate or partially committed operational data.

Built automated data processing and reporting pipelines that classify, aggregate, and enrich Samsara and SQL data, orchestrating scheduled production jobs with Azure Functions and GitHub Actions and implementing failure recovery and deduplication.

Diagnosed production application issues by tracing SQL Server execution flows, identifying data inconsistencies and blocked process states, and applying controlled SQL corrections to restore operational processes.

Led the migration of mission-critical ETL workflows from SQL Server to Google BigQuery, refactoring legacy T-SQL logic and building a Python-based QA framework to validate data consistency across large-scale inventory datasets.

Designed and implemented a Salesforce-to-BigQuery replication architecture using Google Datastream, automated dataset validation, and dynamic object streaming through GCP REST APIs, reducing data latency to near real-time levels.
Built a reusable multi-source replication module for SQL Server and Salesforce, improving code maintainability, error handling, and extensibility across replication workflows.
Operated and monitored CDC-based replication pipelines for SQL-to-SQL and SQL-to-BigQuery synchronization, ensuring reliable data consistency across environments.
